verdict.rationale: Supabase ships a first-party AI Assistant embedded in the Dashboard plus an official MCP server and Agent Skills that let AI assistants query databases, manage migrations, and deploy Edge Functions via natural language, satisfying the ai-native operability story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking of NL command reliability/accuracy, and a fuller account of mitigations for the documented prompt-injection risk that shows in real-world exploitation of the same NL-driven MCP interface.
